q: Montel's theorem, which is fundamental in complex dynamics, states that a family of holomorphic functions is normal (has a locally uniformly convergent subsequence) if:
opts: The functions omit two distinct values in ℂ
The functions have uniformly bounded derivative
exp: Montel's theorem (great Picard + normal families): a family omitting two fixed values in ℂ is normal. This is used to show the Fatou set is the maximal domain of normality of the family {fⁿ}.
